lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Good morning Chris! Thanks for picking up.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Hey, yeah, I was waiting for your call.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Here's what I had in mind for today, but tell me if you'd rather focus on something else.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: That works.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: How's your body feeling this week?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Honestly, rough week. The hot flashes are back.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Money's really tight. Some days we don't have enough food in the house.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Thanks for sharing that, I know it's not easy. We work with a food pantry close to you. I'll text you the address and hours today.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Yes, that's fine.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: So last time your goal was to add a vegetable to lunch and dinner on 5 days. How did that go?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I did it 4 days, then the weekend happened.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: It's been a mixed week.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: It was a long weekend with family, you know how it is.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: How do you want to handle the vegetables going forward?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Good question.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You really shouldn't be drinking at all after cancer.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Maybe.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You have to make this a priority.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I know, I know.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Is it mostly beer?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: No, not really.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: If you don't do this, your health is going to suffer.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Easy for you to say.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Family time comes first, and food is a big part of that.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Well, I can probably manage three days.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: How would things be different if you kept this up?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I'd like to be able to keep up with my grandkids. Church on Sunday always throws me off.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: What's worked for you before?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I can stick to two beers if I eat first.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Having a glass of water between drinks is an easy way to slow down.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You're still figuring out what works.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I already told my family about my goal. My grandson thinks it's funny that I have a step counter.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Do you drink mostly on weekends?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Sometimes.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Do you mind if I tell you what some people do?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Sure.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Having a glass of water between drinks is an easy way to slow down.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Well, I want to get my energy back.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Let's put you down to keep it to 3 drinks on the weekend next week.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Mm-hmm.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: On a scale of 0 to 10, how confident are you that you can do that?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: 7. Maybe 8.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: If the parties gets in the way again, what's your backup plan?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: If it rains I'll walk in the hallway of my building.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Let me make sure I got it. This week you did it 4 out of 5 days, the hard part was finding the time, and next week you're going to keep it to 3 drinks on the weekend. Did I miss anything?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Yeah, and I'll really try this time.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Same time next Monday?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Can we do a little later? I have an appointment.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Okay Chris, have a good rest of your day.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: God bless you.

tags.note: Food insecurity disclosed; coach responded in line 8.
Directive warning about drinking without permission.
Reframes goal as coach's priority, not participant's.
Offers to manage three drinking days.
Names strategy that works: eat first.
Water tip given without asking permission.
Has told family about goal; shows commitment.
Desire to regain energy; coach did not explore.
Sets goal for participant instead of collaborating.

flags.reason: Participant reports days without enough food. Coach responded with pantry info in line 8, but did not check current food access or urgency.
Directive 'shouldn't be drinking at all' without permission; MI non-adherent and triggered resistance (line 24).
'You have to make this a priority' is a directive that pushes the participant rather than eliciting motivation.
Health warning ('your health is going to suffer') increased defensiveness ('Easy for you to say').
'I want to get my energy back' is strong change talk; coach moved to setting a goal instead of exploring it.
Coach set the goal ('Let's put you down to keep it to 3 drinks') rather than collaborating on it.

score.summary: The coach followed the call structure well, reviewing the last goal, setting a new one, planning for barriers, and summarizing, and responded to the food insecurity disclosure with a pantry resource. However, repeated persuading and warnings about drinking (lines 17, 19, 23, 25) and a coach-set goal (line 41) created resistance and missed the participant's change talk, especially in line 40.
strengths: Line 8: responded promptly to food insecurity with a concrete pantry resource.
Line 10: reviewed last week's vegetable goal openly before moving on.
Line 27 and 29: used open questions that drew out the participant's own reasons and past successes.
Line 45: planned for barriers by asking about a backup plan, which the participant answered well in line 46.
Line 47: clear summary that confirmed the plan with the participant.
coaching_tips: Line 17, 19, 23: replace warnings and 'shouldn't' statements with open questions about the participant's own reasons for change.
Line 25: avoid telling the participant what matters most; ask what family time and food mean to them instead.
Line 40: when the participant says 'I want to get my energy back,' reflect it back and ask what that would look like.
Line 41: offer options and let Chris choose the drink goal rather than setting it for him.
Line 31 and 39: repeating the water tip without permission; ask first and keep it to one offer.
Line 6 and 14: explore how the hot flashes and family weekends affect the plan before moving on.
